query:
-- Terapeutas com psicomotricidade na especialidade
SELECT id, name, email, specialties
FROM users
WHERE specialties LIKE '%sicomotri%' AND role = 'therapist';

-- Assignments com psicomotricidade
SELECT pta.id, pta.patient_id, pta.therapist_user_id, pta.therapy_type,
       u.name as therapist_name
FROM patient_therapist_assignments pta
JOIN users u ON u.id = pta.therapist_user_id
WHERE pta.therapy_type LIKE '%sicomotri%';

-- Agendamentos com psicomotricidade
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, status
FROM appointments
WHERE therapy_type LIKE '%sicomotri%'
GROUP BY status;
